classification.rationale: Possible chat-evidence manipulation; local log mutation has no precise LLM Top 10 category.

title: Mutation command targets session or transcript evidence
description: Pairs a log path with deletion, truncation, redirection, or file-writing syntax.
falsepositives: Approved log retention, redaction, fixture generation, or migration.
investigation: Compare with separately retained originals and determine whether the write was authorized; local hashes alone cannot authenticate evidence.
